_doc: Paths that must not reach main on an agent's own authority. If a PR touches any of these, the 'Risky path review' check FAILS until a human adds the label below. Once that check is REQUIRED (BB_PACE=normal, via BB_Micro_Bridge scripts/sync-branch-protection.mjs), auto-merge simply waits — the PR does not merge itself and nothing has to be remembered. At BB_PACE=fast the job is skipped.
_why_this_exists: AGENTS.md section 4 relies on this gate at BB_PACE=normal. Until 2026-10-06 this repo had no scripts/risky-paths.json and no risky-path-gate.yml, so the gate the contract describes did not exist here (Devin Review, universal-auth PR #22).
_label: Add this label to the PR to release the gate. Applying it is the human review — do not add it from an agent.
label: human-reviewed
_tuning: Patterns are JavaScript regexes (case-SENSITIVE) matched against repo-relative POSIX paths. Err toward catching too much: a false positive costs one label, a false negative merges an auth change unreviewed. If a category gets noisy, narrow THAT pattern rather than deleting the category. Every pattern below was counted against `git ls-files` on 2026-10-06 (a repo-specific pattern that matches nothing is a silent hole — Devin, ProjExp5 PR #7). The auth, ci-and-protection, secrets and deploy categories each match real files here; patterns that match nothing today (Dockerfile, .env, migrations/, money) are kept on purpose as guards for the first such file.

categories.name: auth
categories.why: this repo IS the authentication SDK every BB app signs in through — token handling, DPoP keys, sessions, flows, access decisions
categories._why_entrypoints: Added 2026-10-06 (Devin, universal-auth PR #24): the package entry points (package.json exports ".", "./react", "./extendability") and the components barrel decide WHICH auth and access APIs consumers can call. None matched a pattern above and authz_content_scan is off, so an edit to them was classified routine. ./sw and ./internal are already covered by their directories; ./profile is profile data, not auth. extendability/registry.ts is deliberately NOT listed: it only stores notification-channel adapters, and no SDK code reads them or dispatches through them (2026-10-06: getNotificationChannel/listNotificationChannels have no caller outside src/extendability). Add it here when dispatch lands. test/unit/risky-paths.test.ts pins every entry point.
categories._why_dirs: src/core holds token-manager, storage-crypto, the DPoP keypair and proof, session-watcher and abac; src/flows every sign-in / enroll / recovery / delegation flow; src/sw and src/offline replay authenticated requests; src/internal and src/imperative re-export the client. Filename patterns alone miss most of these (client.ts, proof.ts, pin-flow.ts), and the regexes are case-sensitive, so AuthProvider.tsx needs its own entry.
categories._why_pacts: pacts/ is the consumer contract with the ControlTower BFF auth endpoints — changing it changes what the SDK promises the server.

categories.name: migrations
categories.why: anything that writes schema — not revertable by reverting the commit
categories._note: This repo has no database or migrations of its own (2026-10-06: no migrations/). The two .sql files that exist are integration-test seeds under test/integration/; they are caught on purpose, since they define the users and app rows the auth tests run against.

categories.name: ci-and-protection
categories.why: the guardrails themselves — a PR that weakens the gate must not pass through the gate
categories._why_lib: scripts/lib/watermark-scan.ts is the rule behind verify-watermark-bump.ts, a CI gate.
categories._why_bb_risk: bb-review.mjs reads .bb-risk as a repo-level risk declaration; an unguarded ADD of it would be routine (BB_Tools PR #6, P1 #11).

categories.name: secrets
categories.why: credentials, tokens, key handling — never merge unreviewed
categories._why_npmrc: .npmrc carries the GitHub Packages registry auth line for publishing this package.

categories.name: deploy
categories.why: how the thing ships — the demo deploys to Railway from main, and the package is published to GitHub Packages on tag

categories.name: money
categories.why: billing, payroll, invoicing, QuickBooks posting — errors here cost real money
categories._note: This repo has no money code today (2026-10-06: `git ls-files` finds no payroll, invoice, billing, qbo or qbt file). Kept so the first one added is caught.

_ddl_content_scan: Declared off 2026-10-06: this repo has no database, migration runner or DDL-writing script. To enable, replace false with { dirs, extensions, pattern, max_bytes } (see BB_Micro_Bridge).
_money_content_scan: Declared off 2026-10-06: `git grep -iE "quickbooks|qbo|intuit"` over src/ finds only the error-code string 'qbo_missing' in src/errors.ts, no client import — the SDK posts nothing to QuickBooks. The classifier fails closed if this key is ever removed.
_authz_content_scan: Declared off 2026-10-06: every authorization decision in this repo lives under src/core (abac.ts, entitlements.ts) and src/react/useAccess*, and the entry points that expose them are listed by path too (_why_entrypoints), so the auth category matches all of it by PATH and a content scan would add no coverage. To enable, replace false with { dirs, extensions, pattern, max_bytes }.
_carpool_declare_content_scan: Declared off 2026-10-06: this repo has no carpool-declaration route handlers. The canonical check-risky-paths fails CLOSED on an undeclared scan, so the key must be present.
